entities.summary: The Church of the Holy Salvation or Holy Saviour was a Pre-Romanesque Roman Catholic church in the Dalmatian Hinterland, Croatia, whose ruins are now a historic site. It is located in the small village of Cetina, near the spring of the river Cetina, 8 km northwest from the town of Vrlika.
